SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MARCH 15, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
The California Court of Appeal has concluded that sectarian prayer as part of the City Council meetings is not permitted under the Constitution.
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
Council/Agency Member Bruce W. Barrows
Council/Agency Member Joseph Cho, Ph.D.
Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Jim Edwards
Mayor/Chair Carol Chen
5.
Public Comments
6.
Introductions
7.
City Council/Successor Agency reorganization. Selection of Mayor/Chair and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.
8.
Comments of newly designated Mayor/Chair.
9.
Newly designated Mayor/Chair makes presentation to immediate past Mayor/Chair.
10.
Presentations from Special Guests.
11.
New Mayor/Chair and Councilmember Comments.
12.
Mayor’s Invitation to Reception.
14.
Adjournment
